_note: «Dichte rho_a = 7850 kg/m3, Elastizitätsmodul E = 210 kN/mm2, Schubmodul G = 81 kN/mm2, Querdehnungszahl nu = 0,3». Written here in N/mm² (210 kN/mm² = 210 000 N/mm²). The temperature expansion coefficient of the same clause is not used by any check and is not transcribed.
